skills.name: clean-room-analyst
skills.description: Study how an existing product works from the outside (public docs, its UI, its public API, open-source code under its licence) and turn that into an original feature-parity spec ForgeOS can build. Use when a founder says "build something like X" or wants an open-source alternative.

skills.name: code-reviewer
skills.description: Review a diff or a codebase for correctness bugs, security holes and needless complexity, and report findings ranked by severity with file:line references. Use after features are written and before the ship gate.

skills.name: india-compliance
skills.description: India-first defaults for products ForgeOS builds - INR pricing with 18% GST and SAC codes, DPDP Act 2023 privacy requirements, Indian Contract Act 1872 terms and Mumbai jurisdiction. Use for any product sold to Indian users.

skills.name: spec-writer
skills.description: Turn an idea or a clean-room analysis into a buildable product spec with user stories, acceptance criteria, data model and a stack recommendation. Use before any code is written.

skills.name: test-writer
skills.description: Write automated tests from a spec's acceptance criteria - unit tests for logic, API tests for endpoints, and Playwright end-to-end tests for the core user flows. Use when a feature is implemented or when QA finds a gap.

skills.name: secrets-rotation-check
skills.description: Monthly read-only re-verification of credentials that have known exposure risk — the Discord webhook used by agents/outreach.py, plus any credential ever exposed in a screenshot, chat log, or commit (discovered fresh each run from git history and session notes, since no static exposure list exists in this repo). Confirms whether each one is still live/unrotated. Never modifies files, never rotates anything itself — flags for human rotation. Use monthly, or immediately after any suspected exposur

skills.name: security-audit
skills.description: Read-only security audit of the ForgeOS repo. Searches full git history for leaked secrets, verifies .gitignore coverage and that no .env is tracked, runs npm audit / pip-audit for HIGH+CRITICAL CVEs, flags risky GitHub Actions workflow patterns (pull_request_target + untrusted checkout), flags hardcoded IPs/URLs/credentials, and confirms secrets are Doppler-backed rather than ad hoc os.environ/process.env reads. Reports CRITICAL/HIGH/LOW findings with file:line references. Never modifies files.
